_comment: Procedural events. biomes: 'any' or list. time: any|day|night|dusk|dawn. where: water|bank|fishing|sky|settlement. chance: relative weight when eligible. cooldown in seconds.

events.name: Stranded Traveller
events.desc: Someone is waving from the bank. Their canoe has a hole in it.

events.name: Drifting Boat
events.desc: An empty little boat drifts past, rope trailing. Someone upstream will be missing it.

events.name: Fish Run
events.desc: The water boils with rising fish. For a while, every cast here is lucky.

events.name: Golden Hour Run
events.desc: The river turns to fire, and something gold is rising with it.

events.name: Travelling Merchant
events.desc: A merchant's raft, stacked with curiosities, drifts alongside. Rare goods at fair prices.

events.name: Mysterious Light
events.desc: A small light bobs among the trees, just out of reach. When you come close, it leaves something behind.

events.name: Meteor Shower
events.desc: Shooting stars streak across the sky, dozens of them.

events.name: Aurora
events.desc: Green and violet curtains ripple across the northern sky.

events.name: Glowing Water
events.desc: The water lights up blue wherever your oars touch it.

events.name: Lantern Festival
events.desc: The village is floating lanterns on the river tonight. Everyone is invited.

events.name: Boat Race
events.desc: A local rower challenges you to a race to the next bend.

events.name: Heron Migration
events.desc: Great flocks pass overhead, calling to each other.

events.name: Message in a Bottle
events.desc: Something glints in the water: a bottle with a note inside.

events.name: Abandoned Campsite
events.desc: A cold fire ring, a forgotten pack. Whoever was here left in a hurry, or didn't need these things anymore.
